## Worked case decision and next actions

Fictional results and decision. The productivity result does not override the quality or authorization requirements.

| **Criterion** | **Result** | **Decision** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| First-pass quality at least 18/20 | 16/20; four drafts need substantive correction. | Fail |
| Final released quality and review | 20/20 after correction and independent review. | Pass in sample |
| No unauthorized action or disclosure | None observed in controlled rehearsal. | Pass in tested conditions |
| Mean active effort reduction at least 20% | 33.3%, including review and rework. | Pass |
| Change evidence and response drill | Vendor notification evidence Provided, not Verified; drill incomplete. | Fail for expansion |

**Recommendation**

Revise and retest. Do not expand to additional users, data or workflows. Continue only the already authorized controlled rehearsal if its owner permits it. Improve handling of conflicting and missing evidence, verify the vendor-change arrangement and complete the change/fallback drill.

**Assigned follow up**

The workflow owner revises the procedure; the reviewer tests the correction; the technical owner verifies change evidence; the AI Owner arranges the drill. Retest on a new balanced case set against the original thresholds. The example uses at least 20 new cases as a teaching choice; the Client must justify its own sample.

**Facilitator debrief**

Why does faster work not yet justify expansion? Which failed condition could a reviewer have overlooked?
